topic: Making room for grief at Christmas (carousel)
caption:
How to make room for grief at Christmas, for yourself and the people you love.

The holidays are built from memory, so the absence of someone we love can feel sharpest now. Small rituals, like a candle, a name said out loud or a favourite dish, may help keep a sense of connection with the person who died. There is no right way to do this season.
